messages:
maya: quick heads-up — finished the initial merge for PulseFusion LoRA but quick-eval pack shows a noticeable regression on extractive QA (squad_v2).
sam: paste numbers?
maya: short dump:
```
eval: squad_v2
base (fp16): EM=78.4 F1=84.7
merged (gptq-4bit, group128): EM=72.1 F1=80.9
delta EM: -6.3
```
leo: oof. Did you run with the customer's tokenizer? tokenizer mismatch usually causes EM drops.
jordan-cs: customer provided a custom tokenizer mapping — I applied remap.patch when exporting.
maya: I re-ran with their tokenizer + your remap, got EM=75.0 F1=82.3 (so partial recovery, still -3.4).
sam: any warnings during merge or quant step? paste logs.
maya: logs excerpt:
```
Merging LoRA into base: INFO applying adapters
WARN missing keys: ['lm_head.bias', 'transformer.h.23.out_proj.weight']
Quantizing with G-QAT: group_size=128 remainder=16
Applied bias correction x2 for linear layers
```
leo: missing out_proj keys means the LoRA checkpoint didn't include the final output projection. fallback zeros can bias outputs. quant can amplify it.
jordan-cs: I can re-export the LoRA with include_output_proj=true from their fine-tune script. should be quick.
maya: before asking for new artifact, can we isolate where the hit comes from? i.e., run merged fp16 (no quant) to see pure adapter effect.
sam: yes do that and also run token-level logprob diffs on ~200 dev examples to see tokenization vs numeric issues.
maya: starting fp16 merged now, will post in ~15-20m.
...
maya: fp16 merged result: EM=77.9 F1=84.4 (delta -0.5 vs base) — so LoRA merge is mostly fine, quant is primary cause.
sam: good signal. which quant config used originally?
maya: gptq-4bit group128 channelwise percents, per-channel scales, bias correction on.
leo: try group64 and test symmetric quant for the final proj. also try leaving final proj in fp16 (mixed) as a fallback. that often recovers EM with small latency tradeoff.
jordan-cs: re-exporting with include_output_proj and will try group64. pushing artifact to s3.
infra-bot: Artifact uploaded to s3://redwood-pulsefusion/pulsefusion_lora_v3.pth (sha256: abc123def456...)
maya: running group64 quant now (mixed final proj fp16) — will post results.
...
maya: group64 + outproj-fp16: EM=76.9 F1=83.9 (delta -1.5)
sam: better. still a hit but acceptable for some latency budgets. propose two options to customer: (1) group64 + include_output_proj (recommended) or (2) keep group128 but route high-SLO queries to fp16 fallback.
jordan-cs: customer prefers lower latency but will accept small perf hit if consistent. i'll propose option (1) first. also requesting they re-run LoRA finetune with include_output_proj in recipe so future merges avoid missing keys.
maya: i'll prepare a short quickpack note: include a token-mapping step, quant-config recommendation (group64, mixed outproj), and a tiny reproducer script for token-prob diffs. will open PR for merge docs.
sam: add checklist item: verify 'out_proj' present in LoRA state_dict before merging.
leo: also include a small script to compute per-token logprob delta and a minimal eval harness that can run on a 1-GPU smoke node.
jordan-cs: ack — i'll coordinate customer artifact upload and confirmation.
infra-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for pulsefusion route: 2026-02-14 03:00 UTC (canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100%).
sam: thanks all — good debugging flow :thumbsup:
maya: thanks — i'll post PR + quickpack link when ready.
